subject: Request: Net terms backdate, VAT evidence & min-commit exception
messages:
From: Sofia Marquez <sofia@acme-media.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Kyle Nguyen <kyle@acme-media.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: apply net terms retroactively + VAT cert & min-commit exception

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme is excited to get started. Procurement has routed the PO (attached) but we hit two operational items that need alignment before we can finalize:

1) Net terms backdate: Our procurement team needs the invoice for the onboarding charge (PO #112233) to reflect Net 30 from the invoice date of 2027-10-25 to match our payment cycle. Can Redwood apply Net-30 terms retroactively to that invoice or provide a formal credit/adjustment so our accounting can process to the same cycle?

2) Tax evidence: To reclaim VAT/restore correct tax treatment we need Redwood to provide a VAT certificate or tax residency evidence and a copy of Redwood’s tax ID. Please advise what you can share (PDF is fine).

3) Minimum commit exception: Because this is our pilot quarter we’re requesting an exception on the annual minimum commit for Q4 so it isn’t pro-rated to full year. If that’s not possible, would Redwood consider a one-time waiver or credit?

Can you confirm next steps and whether legal/finance need a signed amendment? We’re trying to close the PO by EOD Nov 5. I’ve copied Kyle from procurement for timing.

Attachments: Acme_PO_112233.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Sofia Marquez
Procurement Manager
Acme Media, Inc.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: apply net terms retroactively + VAT cert & min-commit exception

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Acme’s ask. TL;DR: they want Net-30 applied retroactively to an invoice dated 2027-10-25, VAT/tax docs, and a minimum-commit exception for the pilot quarter. They need confirmation by EOD Nov 5 to sign the PO.

Questions for legal: are we ok to backdate net terms or do we need an amendment/countersignature? Any compliance concerns if we accept backdating?

Questions for finance: can we issue a credit memo or reissue invoice with Net-30 effective from Oct 25? If we offer a one-time credit for the min-commit, what’s the finance process and impact to recognition?

Options I’m considering so we can respond quickly:
- Quick amendment: one-paragraph orderform amendment capturing the retro net term and min-commit exception; countersign and apply.
- Credit memo: process a credit equal to the payment timing delta or one-time credit for min-commit.
- Decline backdating, offer alternative (one-time credit) — faster but may escalate procurement.

I’ve attached the PO they sent. Marissa, Ben — can you weigh in with recommended path and required artifacts?

Thanks,
Dylan
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_PO_112233.pdf (forwarded)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: apply net terms retroactively + VAT cert & min-commit exception

Dylan / Ben — I reviewed Acme’s request. High-level legal guidance and recommended controls: 

1) Backdating net terms: we can agree to apply Net-30 from an earlier invoice date only if there is a signed amendment or a countersigned orderform that explicitly states the effective invoice date and payment terms. Backdating without a written amendment creates audit and revenue recognition risk. If Acme signs a brief amendment (I’ve attached a one-paragraph template), we can execute on our side quickly.

2) Tax evidence: ask Acme to provide a VAT registration certificate (for EU customers) or a tax-exempt certificate where applicable. We cannot issue VAT-specific credits without them. For US entities, a W-9 is typically sufficient for tax withholding purposes. Keep copies in the customer contract folder.

3) Minimum commit exception: operationally acceptable as a one-time amendment item. Legal prefers the exception be documented in the amendment with a clear expiration (e.g., Q4 2027 only).

4) Exec approval: if the financial impact of the backdating/credit is > $250k, escalate to CFO and Sales Lead for sign-off. Otherwise we can proceed with a standard amendment and credit memo.

I’ve attached an amendment template (orderform_amendment_template.docx) — use that to collect signatures. If Ben confirms finance can issue the credit memo, we can offer Acme the amendment + credit flow and request the VAT docs.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: orderform_amendment_template.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Marquez <sofia@acme-media.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kyle Nguyen <kyle@acme-media.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net terms backdate, VAT evidence & min-commit exception

Hi Sofia (and Kyle),

Thanks for the clear note and PO. Finance confirms we can support the following, subject to the amendment Marissa provided and receipt of the VAT/tax documents:

- We will reissue the onboarding invoice as a corrected invoice reflecting Net-30 effective 2027-10-25 OR issue a credit memo equivalent to the invoice amount with a new invoice dated today showing Net-30. Either approach will allow Acme to calendar to Net-30 with your AP cycle.

- For VAT treatment: please send the VAT registration certificate (PDF) or other applicable tax-exempt documentation. Once we receive it we’ll include the evidence in the billing record.

- Minimum commit: we can apply a one-time waiver for Q4 2027 if Acme signs the amendment confirming the waiver period. The waiver will be documented as a contract amendment and a billing note so revenue recognition is traceable.

Please send: signed amendment (orderform amendment), Acme_VAT_certificate.pdf (if applicable), and the PO. Once those are received we’ll process the credit/reissue within 3 business days.

Next steps: Dylan — please send the amendment template to Sofia and request signatures. Sofia / Kyle — if you can route signed docs back to billing@redwood.ai, we’ll pick this up immediately.

Best,
Ben Carter
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
